data.spec: Canonical ordering/fixing runtime now Leo apps/agent Python. In-process office_procurement validates one need+assessment and read-only Tavily/FINN discovery. office_procurement.planning ranks fixture offers by landed price/quality/delivery; office/procurement_workflow.py persists selected proposal, assessment, discovery and exact approval. /api/input {board_id,text,person?}->augmented task; /api/tasks/:id/decide {approve,proposal_fingerprint?} checks exact persisted pending proposal/current quote; legacy /api/requests/:id/approve requires exact JSON.stringify fingerprint. /api/requests/:id/requote refreshes only unexecuted current snapshot and increments quote_revision. plugin.place_order validates exact product/quantity/current selected source (quality/delivery too), cap/expiry and office approval before one persisted simulated execution. require_approval true by default; false permits routine <=autoNOK with confidence/no model review, including unknown speaker; unverified identity cannot grant authority. Services require review by default. Typed API clients retain existing DeviceEvent/EventResponse shapes via office/legacy.py. Existing input/sensor/board routes unchanged in shape, firmware untouched.
